# LibreOffice Calc GUI Interface Description

## Window Header and Title Bar
- **Application Name**: LibreOffice Calc
- **Document Title**: TaxReturn.xlsx
- **Date and Time Display**: Oct 23 16:56
- **System Tray Icons**: Bell icon (notifications) visible in the top-right corner
- **Window Control Buttons**: Minimize, Maximize, Close buttons in the top-right corner

## Application Menu Bar
- **Menu Options**: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Styles, Sheet, Data, Tools, Window, Help

## Toolbar
- **Font Selection**: Calibri, 11 pt
- **Text Formatting Icons**: Bold (B), Italic (I), Underline (U), Font Color, Background Color
- **Alignment Icons**: Left, Center, Right, Justify
- **Number Formatting Icons**: Decimal places, Percentage, Currency, Scientific notation
- **Cell Formatting Icons**: Borders, Fill color, Font size, Font style
- **Insert Icons**: Image, Chart, Hyperlink, Special characters (Ω), Comment, Table, Pivot table
- **Other Icons**: Cut, Copy, Paste, Undo, Redo, Find, Replace, Spell check, Formula bar

## Status Bar
- **Current Sheet**: Sheet 2 of 2
- **Sheet Tabs**: TaxReturn, Sheet2
- **Language Setting**: English (Hong Kong)
- **Statistics**: Average: ; Sum: 0
- **Zoom Level**: 100%
- **Navigation Controls**: Previous, Next, First, Last sheet navigation buttons

## Worksheet Area
- **Grid Layout**: Rows numbered 1 to 42, Columns labeled A to U
- **Selected Cell**: Cell B4 highlighted with a red border
- **Cell Reference Display**: B4 shown in the name box

## Sidebar
- **Vertical Scrollbar**: Located on the right side of the worksheet
- **Quick Access Icons**: 
  - Format Painter
  - Chart
  - Comment
  - Function Wizard (fx)
  - Conditional Formatting
  - Data Validation
  - Pivot Table

## Notification Bar
- **Information Messages**:
  - "Help us make LibreOffice even better!" with a "Get involved" button
  - "Your donations support our worldwide community." with a "Donate" button
- **Close Buttons**: X buttons next to each message

## Desktop Environment
- **Left Dock**: Application icons including Chrome, Thunderbird, Visual Studio Code, VLC, LibreOffice Writer, LibreOffice Calc, LibreOffice Impress, GIMP, Files, Software Center, Help, Trash
- **Bottom Dock**: System tray and application launcher grid

## Additional UI Elements
- **Formula Bar**: Located below the toolbar, with function symbols (f, Σ, =)
- **Cell Selection Indicator**: Red border around selected cell B4
- **Row and Column Headers**: Clearly labeled with numbers and letters
- **Sheet Navigation**: Tabs for different sheets (TaxReturn, Sheet2) at the bottom

## Visual Design
- **Color Scheme**: Light gray background, white cells, black text
- **Highlighting**: Selected cell B4 has a red border
- **Icons**: Colorful and intuitive icons for various functions
- **Typography**: Clear, readable font for text and numbers

## Functional Elements
- **Cell Selection**: User can select individual cells or ranges
- **Formatting Tools**: Comprehensive tools for text, number, and cell formatting
- **Data Entry**: Ready for data input in selected cell B4
- **Navigation**: Easy navigation through sheets and cells
- **Help and Support**: Access to help documentation and community involvement options

## Layout and Organization
- **Top to Bottom**: Menu bar, toolbar, notification bar, worksheet, status bar
- **Left to Right**: Dock with application icons, worksheet grid, sidebar
- **Logical Grouping**: Related functions grouped together in toolbars and menus
- **Consistent Design**: Uniform design across all elements for ease of use

## User Interaction
- **Mouse Cursor**: Positioned over cell B4, indicating active selection
- **Keyboard Shortcuts**: Likely available for common functions
- **Drag and Drop**: Support for moving and copying data
- **Right-Click Context Menu**: Access to additional options for selected cells

## System Integration
- **Desktop Environment**: Integrated with GNOME desktop environment
- **Application Dock**: Icons for quick access to other applications
- **System Tray**: Notifications and system status indicators
- **Language Support**: Multilingual interface with English (Hong Kong) setting

## Accessibility Features
- **High Contrast**: Clear distinction between text and background
- **Large Icons**: Easy to identify and use
- **Keyboard Navigation**: Likely supported for accessibility
- **Screen Reader Compatibility**: Text-based elements for assistive technologies

## Customization Options
- **Font and Size**: Adjustable via toolbar
